title: NOP items
description: A bunch of usefully useless items. Heavily inspired by worldedit coloured tools, and intended for a similar purpose.
body:
# NOP Items

This mod adds items that do nothing - 126 of them, in fact.
Why would you want those? Simple - to bind them to worldedit brushes, wands, etc.
They only exist in creative - they cannot be crafted and they do not craft - so worldedit will no longer interfere with your survival gameplay!

This mod is heavily inspired by [Worldedit Coloured Tools](https://modrinth.com/mod/wectools), but with a few more items and (hopefully) slightly more contrast between them.

These items are totally interchangeable, but there are some recomended usages:
* _colour_ _tool_ - WE brushes
* rainbow _tool_ - Big, powerfull WE brushes?
* wand axe - WE selection wand
* wand stick - Litematica wand
* wand pearl - WE navigation wand
* wand sword - Maybe some mod item to function as an entity clearer?
* wand _tool_ - other mod wand items

## But what does NOP mean

To save you some googling:
Back in _ye olden days_ of computing, people had to give the computer instructions one by one such as "add these, multiply these, store that" (simplified). One instruction most computers had was "NOP" or "No OPeration" which did absolutely nothing and that was why it was usefull.
